skills.name: clickable-brief
skills.note: Hand-authored directly through an agent session -- no external source to pull from, so the dotfiles copy under local-skills/clickable-brief/ IS the source of truth (not a stale mirror of something else).

The 'Animations on the Web' course skill set (animations.dev). One installer call produces all of these. Requires animationsdev_token in ~/.config/chezmoi/chezmoi.toml's [data] section on THIS machine (a personal license token -- never hardcode it here, this file is public on GitHub). get_secret() reads it whether or not the chezmoi binary itself is installed (falls back to parsing chezmoi.toml directly), but the value still has to actually be present in that file on each machine -- it's never synced by dotfiles itself.

skills.name: yuanbao
skills.note: Yuanbao groups skill. local-skills/yuanbao/ is the source of truth.

Official Dart team skill set. Installed via npx skills add but shows source:null in `npx skills list --json` on this machine (same as herdr above -- --agent claude-code copies files rather than symlinking, which drops source attribution) -- tracked by name to match actual detected state. Upstream README suggests --agent universal instead (installs to the shared .agents/skills dir, source-tracked there); switch to that + a plain .source entry if this ever needs to target a non-Claude agent that reads .agents/skills directly. dart-setup-ffi-assets flagged Med/Critical risk in the installer's own security scan (Gen Risk column) -- every other skill in the set came back Safe; review before relying on it.

plugins.note: Depends on the non-portable tutor-marketplace above.

Nudges the agent toward minimal, non-over-engineered diffs (reuse/stdlib/native before writing new code). Also installable for other agents per its own README, neither of which this manifest tracks (only claude/hermes/pi) -- reference only, not auto-synced: Codex (`codex plugin marketplace add DietrichGebert/ponytail` then `codex plugin add ponytail@ponytail`); GitHub Copilot CLI (`copilot plugin marketplace add DietrichGebert/ponytail` then `copilot plugin install ponytail@ponytail`). No Hermes install exists -- ponytail's README doesn't cover it.

Official Flutter/Dart team plugin -- bundles Flutter/Dart skills (widget tests, layout-error fixes, JSON serialization, go_router setup, etc.) plus the Dart MCP server. Full per-agent breakdown: https://docs.flutter.dev/ai/get-started (also covers Cursor, Codex, Antigravity, GitHub Copilot, and generic MCP clients -- none tracked in this manifest). No native Hermes plugin equivalent (Hermes has its own separate plugin format), but the skills alone (no MCP bundling) could be pulled into Hermes via `hermes skills tap add flutter/agent-plugins` if ever wanted -- not added as an auto-synced hermes install here since that path is unverified.

hermes._comment: Hermes state here is the real ZimaBoard instance (ssh zima), not this Mac's local ~/.hermes shell/client. Skills are shared top-level; agents.hermes.skills is for Hermes-only extras.

pi._comment: Placeholder. No 'pi' binary or config exists yet. Adding real support later is data-only: add entries to top-level skills with an install.pi, then add 'pi' branches to the detect_/sync_/drift_ functions in sync-agent-tools.sh. No new hook mechanism needed.
